title: Unreadable placeholder text in dark mode on new note screen
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in NotesPlus, the user encountered: Unreadable placeholder text in dark mode on new note screen.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: New note
2. Observe UI state: Dark theme enabled
3. Observe UI state: Start writing...

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Start writing....

## Environment
- App: NotesPlus
- Platform: android
